title: native YAML rule set (schema v1)
description: Structural contract for the native YAML rule format. This is a purpose-built, versioned rule DSL. It is NOT Falco-compatible and makes no Falco rule-syntax compatibility claim. The JSON Schema enforces structural shape (required keys, enums, no unknown fields, version/engine typing, and a character-length pre-bound on regex patterns). Deeper semantic bounds that JSON Schema cannot express. regex byte length (<= 1024 bytes), regex capture-group count (<= 64), absence of unbounded/nested quantifiers, event-field catalog membership, operator/field-type compatibility, unique rule/list/sequence identifiers, engine-version compatibility, condition nesting depth, list recursion, and the deny-only-on-kernel-observable-field rule. are enforced by the compiled semantic validator in the `rules` crate (parse_ruleset). Both layers together form the rule schema.

schema_version.description: Rule schema version. The structural type is integer here; the semantic validator enforces the exact value 1 and rejects any other version with a path-aware SchemaVersionMismatch diagnostic.

engine_version.description: Engine version this rule set is compatible with (semver, e.g. "1.0.0"). The semantic validator enforces compatibility with the running engine and rejects stale or newer-major versions with an EngineVersionMismatch diagnostic.

rules.description: The rules in this rule set. May be empty (an empty rule set is valid).

id.description: Unique rule identifier (e.g. "sensitive-file-write"). Must be unique across the rule set.

source.description: Event source this rule applies to.

description.description: Human-readable description of what the rule detects. Must be non-empty.

condition.description: The match condition. A condition is exactly one of: a leaf field match, an AND combinator, an OR combinator, or a NOT combinator.

action.description: Action taken on a match. `deny` is only permitted when the condition references kernel-observable fields (enforced semantically); deny on heuristic-only/enrichment data is rejected.

exceptions.description: Optional scoped exceptions that suppress a match.

lists.description: Optional reusable, immutable string lists. List names must be unique and lists must not reference each other cyclically.

sequences.description: Optional ordered temporal sequences. Sequence names must be unique.

condition.description: A condition is exactly one variant (mutually exclusive): a leaf field match, an AND combinator, an OR combinator, or a NOT combinator. This maps onto the canonical Condition AST (Field | And | Or | Not).

field.description: Event field to match (e.g. "file.path", "process.exec_path", "network.dst_ip"). Must be a member of the event field catalog (enforced semantically).

value.description: Regex pattern. Character-length pre-bound (<= 1024 chars). The semantic validator additionally enforces <= 1024 BYTES, <= 64 capture groups, successful compilation, and no unbounded/nested quantifiers.

or.description: At least one child condition must match.

condition_operator.description: Full operator set for leaf conditions. The semantic validator further restricts operators by field type (e.g. ordering operators only on numeric fields).

scoped_operator.description: Operator subset allowed in exceptions and sequence steps (ordering operators gt/lt/gte/lte are not permitted in these scoped positions).

value.description: The match value. Type depends on the operator and field type (enforced semantically). `in`/`not_in` require an array value.

items.description: List items. Must be non-empty. An item must not name another list (recursion guard, enforced semantically).

steps.description: Ordered sequence steps. Must be non-empty.

window_seconds.description: Correlation time window in seconds. Must be >= 1.
